verdict.rationale: OpenRouter automatically fails over across providers when one is down, and the `models` array lets you set an ordered fallback list that is tried on errors or rate limits. The `provider` object also lets you customize routing, and a community user confirms fallback works by default without custom wrappers. This is failover rather than a configurable retry policy: no evidence shows retry counts, backoff, or per-error-class retry rules. Missing for 10: configurable retry count/backoff settings, same-provider retry controls for transient errors, documentation of which error classes trigger retries.
